Team —

Quick readout from the Q1 pulse (summary attached to the Drive link below). Overall score is within expected variance, but there are three distinct micro-clusters where engagement dropped >15% vs. last quarter and a pair of sensitive attrition flags surfaced (two ICs on short notice patterns + manager escalation concerns). I’ve highlighted the areas below and proposed next steps.

High-level:
- Micro-cluster A (Platform infra): lower manager clarity + overloaded sprint queues
- Micro-cluster B (ML infra): perceived lack of growth path for senior ICs
- Micro-cluster C (Customer Integrations): workload spike + onboarding bottlenecks
- Sensitive flags: two individuals (private) showing short-notice leaves + low 1:1 sentiment scores

Action asks:
1) Marcus — please coordinate with managers in A/B to run 30-minute focused manager touchpoints this week; use the attached manager-action-log template to capture commitments (deadline: Mon 3/15).
2) Evelyn — can you lead an immediate risk triage for the two sensitive flags with People Ops and advise if we should extend interim EAP/support? CC vendor if needed.
3) Vivek — patch resource forecast for C (quick 30m) and confirm if we can reallocate two SRE shifts to reduce on-call fatigue.

I’m marking this sensitive — share only with the recipients above and People Ops. I’ll collect the manager logs and consolidate to present in next Monday’s exec sync.

Lauren
